Op de campus staat een gedeelde tafel na: On campus, a shared table stands beside a circular bench. Students often walk past alone. Some want a quiet place to share a personal story; others want to draw together or share food. One student says: “A circular bench feels welcoming, but for a personal story I want a quiet place.” Another student is looking for a playful atmosphere. A shared table can encourage people to share food. How can we create a place where strangers feel comfortable starting a conversation?
